wire.headline: Energy Firm Reports Mixed Results Amid Job Cuts and Regulatory Scrutiny
sentences: The company recorded revenue of 4.26bn GBP for the quarter ending 30 September, representing a 7% year-on-year increase.
Pre-tax profit decreased by 12% to 310m GBP during the same period.
The firm announced plans to cut 850 jobs, which accounts for approximately 6% of its workforce.
Two gas plants, located in Wales and Kent, are scheduled to close by March 2027.
CEO Marian Holt stated that the company is facing cost pressure that is sharper than expected.
The regulator Ofgem has opened an investigation into the company's billing system.
The dividend has been held at 12.4p a share.
Shares fell by 4.2% in morning trading.
